arabic text: DUA E FATEMA HAI GIRYA O ZAARI NA CHORENGE\nHAM APNI JAAN DE DENGE AZAADAARI NA CHORENGE
english translation text: IT'S A DUA OF FATEMA (SO) WE WILL NOT ABANDON MOURNING OR AZADARI.\nWE WILL GIVE UP OUR LIVES BUT NEVER RELINQUISH THIS AZADARI.

arabic text: NA HOTI GAR DUA E FATEMA PHIR HAM KAHAAN HOTE\nAGAR YE GHAM NAHI HOTA TO EHLE GHAM KAHAAN HOTE\nJANAABE SAYYADA KI FARMABARDAARI NA CHORENGE
english translation text: WHERE WOULD WE BE WITHOUT DUA E FATEMA\nIF THERE WAS NO MOURNING (FOR HUSSAIN) WHERE WOULD THE MOURNERS BE\nWE WILL NEVER ABANDON SAYYEDA FATEMA'S DUA( REQUEST)

arabic text: HAM APNI JAAN DE DENGE AZAADAARI NA CHORENGE.
english translation text: WE WILL GIVE UP OUR LIVES BUT NEVER RELINQUISH THIS AZADARI.

arabic text: KABHI BHI KAARWAANE NUSRATE SHEH RUK NAHI SAKTA\nHAMAARA SAR KATE KAT JAAYE LEKIN JHUK NAHI SAKTA\nALI KE MAAN NE WAALE HAIN KHUD DAARI NA CHORENGE
english translation text: THE CARAVAN WITH HELPERS OF HUSSAIN CANNOT STOP\nOUR HEADS CAN BE CUT OFF BUT WILL NEVER BOW\nWE ARE FOLLOWERS OF ALI AND NEVER STOP STANDING UP (FOR THE RIGHT)

arabic text: ZAMAANE KO SABAK SIKH LAAGAYE KARBOBALA WAALE\nSITAMGAR KI HIMAAYAT KAR NAHI SAKTE\nKHUDA WAALE KISI MAZLUM O BEKAS KI TARAFDAARI NA CHORENGE
english translation text: THE PEOPLE OF KARBALA LEFT A LESSON FOR ALL TIMES\nWE WILL NEVER SUPPORT OPPRESSORS\nWE ARE BELIEVERS AND WILL NEVER ABANDON SUPPORTING THE OPPRESSED

arabic text: KHUDA KA DIN BAAQI MUSTAFA KI SHAAN BAAQI HAI\nHUSSAINI MAJLISON SE JAZBA E IMAAN BAAQI HAI\nRAKHENGE MASJIDEIN AABAAD DINDAARI NA CHORENGE
english translation text: THE RELIGION OF ALLH(SWT) AND MUSTAFA'S HONOUR IS INTACT\nTHE MAJALIS OF HUSSAIN HAS HAS PROTECTED OUR FAITH(IMAAN)\nWE WILL FILL THE MOSQUES AND NEVER ABANDON THE RELIGION

arabic text: BATAAYENGE SABHI KO DAASTAAN PYAAS AUR PAANI KI\nSABEELE AAB HOGI YAAD ME TASHNADAHAANI KI\nALI ASGHAR TUMHAARI NAAZ BARDAARI NA CHORENGE
english translation text: WE WILL PROPAGATE THE STORY OF THIRST AND WATER\nWE WILL DISTRIBUTE WATER IN COMMEMORATING THE THIRST(OF KARBALA)\nALI ASHGHAR, WE WILL NEVER ABANDON REMEMBERING YOUR PLIGHT

arabic text: LABE SHABBIR PE SOYA PAHER KI PYAAS KE SADQE\nHAME SAB KUCH MILA HAI PARCHAME ABBAS KE SADQE\nKHUDA NE HAATH BAKHSHE HAIN ALAMDAARI NA CHORENGE
english translation text: FOR THE SAKE OF NOON'S THIRST, IT SLEPT ON THE LIPS OF SHABBIR.\nWE HAVE ATTAINED EVERYTHING THROUGH THE INTERCESSION OF HADHRAT ABBAS\nGOD HAS BLESSED US WITH HANDS AND WE WILL NEVER ABANDON CARRYING THE ALAM

arabic text: EK AYSA BEWATAN JISKA JANAAZA BHI NAHI UTTHA\nWO ARZE KARBALA AUR BEKAFAN SHABBIR KA LAASHA\nQASAM KHAATE HAIN HARGIZ TAAZYA DAARI NA CHORENGE
english translation text: THERE WAS A STRANGER WHO WAS NOT ACCORDED A FUNERAL\nTHE LAND OF KARBALA AND THE UNSHROUDED BODY OF SHABBIR\nWE MAKE A COVENANT NEVER TO ABANDON CARRYING TAZIYA

arabic text: HAM EK DIN MAQSADE KARBOBALA SAB KO BATAA DENGE\nHUSSAINI HAIN YAZIDIYAT KO DUNYA SE MITA DENGE\nKABHI ISLAAM KE DUSHMAN SE BEZAARI NA CHORENGE
english translation text: WE WILL SUCCEED IN PROPAGATING THE PURPOSE OF KARBALA TO EVERYONE\nWE ARE FOLLOWERS OF HUSSAIN AND WILL ERADICATE YAZIDIYAT\nWE WILL NEVER ABANDON STANDING UP TO THE ENEMIES OF ISLAM
